questions.question: It was only when I had finished my homework that I realized I had forgotten to buy milk. This made me feel extremely frustrated because _______.
options: I had wasted a lot of time
my mother would be very angry with me
I couldn't have dinner as planned
the shop was closed
questions.answer: I couldn't have dinner as planned

questions.question: Unless I had studied harder, _______.
options: I would not have passed the exam
my parents would be disappointed in me
I wouldn't have been able to get a good job
the teacher would have given me a lower grade
questions.answer: I would not have passed the exam

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the party, _______.
options: all my friends were already there
the music was extremely loud
there wasn't enough food to go around
my host had forgotten about me
questions.answer: all my friends were already there

questions.question: The new policy, which has been implemented in many countries, _______.
options: is a response to the growing concern about climate change
has been met with widespread criticism from environmental groups
requires companies to pay a significant fine if they don't comply
will have a positive impact on the economy
questions.answer: is a response to the growing concern about climate change

questions.question: What I was saying, _______, is that we need to take action now.
options: was that our country's future is at stake
was that it's not too late to make a difference
is that the government should be held responsible
was that we're running out of time
questions.answer: was that our country's future is at stake
